facts.fact: The Council of Ministers adopted on 29 January 2026 a draft ordinance setting the rules for digital payments in Gabon, taken under decree 0388/PR/MENNTI of 16 November 2024, to fill the legal vacuum around digital payment operations.
facts.system: Projet d'ordonnance fixant les regles applicables aux paiements digitaux

facts.fact: The communique says the draft ordinance is made in conformity with the CEMAC community provisions in force on digital payments; it names no regulation or year.
